# Installation observation fixtures

These fixtures use a synthetic radio identity and non-secret publisher bytes.
`approved.hex` is the exact PDUPGR01 record consumed by the native host fixture.
`committed.json` and `rolled_back.json` are generated by the production Go reader
and JSON encoding from the actual C publisher's protected tmpfs files. The Qt
monitor tests consume these to check binary-plan hashing and cross-language
observation matching.

From the repository root, after building the native host fixture:

```sh
python3 tools/pd-waveform/boot/test_installation.py \
  --checker /path/to/installation-check \
  --go-shim tools/flex-tailnet-shim \
  --export-fixtures tools/flex-tailnet-shim/testdata/aetherpd/installation \
  InstallationTest.test_native_publication_read_by_go
```

The fixture replaces only native owner checks with the invoking UID. No radio
connection, privileged service, real credential, or signing seed is involved.
